instructorNote: This inject puts two quick fixes in front of the players. The clerk wants to send a WEA that would duplicate the NWS warning (BWN 5 rules this out), and the patrol offers to drive into the warned area. Watch for the Warning Officer to refuse the WEA, log the N-07 and N-11 failures with times, and reach the parks another way (park manager phone tree, NOAA Weather Radios, a Channel 6 mention), and for the Field Incident Commander to keep SO-214 outside the polygon.
